textual.potential_relevance: A notable retail-value voucher claim is directly linked to submitting personal information, returning and shipping a product, and following a specified claims process; the relationship may require later assessment of whether the described process and conditions are accurately represented.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the process, websites, voucher, product defect, or stated value are genuine, authorized, or successful. The ASR may contain transcription errors.
